about_the_game:
If you’re looking for an iconic soundtrack featuring vibrant mashups of decades of music history, reimagined for a new generation, the Platypus soundtrack is what you should be listening to. Featuring selections from legendary remix albums of classic Commodore 64 chiptunes including the “Back in Time” series and Karma 64, iconic tracks such as “Wizball 2000”, “Comic Bakery” and "Sanxion" make this soundtrack legendary on its own. 

These tracks fuse dance, orchestral, new-age, and progressive rock influences into unforgettable remixes of classic tunes by 80s chiptune legends like Martin Galway and Rob Hubbard. They open up the auditory journey for a nostalgic approach to earlier generations and new discovery of high-energy beats for the newer generations. Listening to the soundtrack cements the unique charm that made Platypus a cult classic.

Once only heard in snippets within the original game, the full high-quality versions will make you remember why you fell in love with Platypus. If you are just discovering it for the first time, this soundtrack is a joyful celebration of retro creativity, packed with nostalgia and timeless energy. Take a listen and dive in through decades of gaming history.
